title: apricitus-score: references() and the @id form
description:
`design/storage.md` §3.2 (`apricitus-score`).

## Steps
1. `pub struct Ref { alias: String, source: String, slice: Option<String>, kit_pad: Option<String> }` and `pub fn references(score: &Score, base_dir: &Path) -> Vec<Ref>`:
   - every clip with its source path and optional slice;
   - every drum-kit pad that names a clip and slice, e.g. `crash = band slice hit-3` → `kit_pad: Some("drums.crash")`;
   - chopped kits reference their clip.
2. The optional id form: a clip source may be `@clp_…` and a slice `@slc_…`. The DSL and YAML accept and round-trip them; resolution happens later in the loader (apricitus-115d2e).
3. Tests in `crates/apricitus-score/tests/references.rs`: for each file in `examples/`, the expected references (hand-checked), plus id-form round trips through `apricitus fmt`.

## Verify
`cargo test -p apricitus-score`
